doc: A finished rock, ready to draw and to skin with a rock_v1_pose: the whole rock on bone 0 and every break piece on its own bone, built at a lower level of detail.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius: the rock's footprint, metres.

fields.name: bone_a
fields.doc: Bone per vertex: 0 for the whole rock, 1 + n for piece n.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex (the same as bone_a; rocks are rigid).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).
